title: Great Location Near Gulch, 12 South & Broadway
description:
Stay at "Mix" at 8th & Argyle, a premium Nashville vacation rental collection. This edgy musical retreat sits on legendary 8th Ave South, Nashville's hidden gem! Just 2.3 miles to Broadway, even closer to The Gulch & 12th South, walk to Hattie B's hot chicken, live music at The Basement & Eighth Room, Zanies comedy, 8th & Roast coffee. Professionally designed with class & modern amenities. 2-car garage + hotel-grade linen cleaning. Publix nearby. A perfect Nashville experience!

The space
Perfectly Designed for Groups - 4 Levels of Comfort & Privacy:
This thoughtfully designed 4-level home sleeps up to 12 guests with an ideal layout that balances togetherness and personal space, featuring bedrooms on levels 1, 3, and 4 each with private ensuite bathrooms, while the expansive 2nd level serves as the heart of the home with an open-concept kitchen, dining, and living area flowing onto a balcony off the kitchen—plus a convenient half bath so no one needs to trek to their room. The massive 4th-level bedroom doubles as a second living area with ample seating and its own private patio accessible through a sleek modern garage door. With 2 full living areas, 3 outdoor spaces (including the 3rd bedroom balcony), and every bedroom having its own bathroom, this layout eliminates typical group rental challenges—whether your crew wants to gather in the main living space or spread out across the secondary 4th floor living room, 2 patios, and private bedrooms, everyone has their perfect spot with no cramped quarters or bathroom lines, just pure comfort and flexibility.
